_comment: Manual dependency edges that ci-scripts/commit_impact.py cannot discover from the CMake File API codemodel, because the dependency is a runtime dlopen() of a MODULE library (via shlib_loader / loader.<component>.shlibversion) rather than a CMake target_link_libraries/add_dependencies edge. Each rule fires when a changed file's path starts with any of `path_prefixes`, and adds `executables` to the affected set unconditionally, in addition to whatever the CMake graph finds.

rules.name: radios
rules.description: Radio driver backends (radio/*) are dlopen'd by shlib_loader at runtime based on the configured RU type; no executable links against them at build time, so they have zero edges in the CMake graph.

rules.name: vrtsim-oru
rules.description: vrtsim is additionally used by nr-oru (on top of the general radios rule above).

rules.name: dfts
rules.description: The dfts MODULE (DFT/FFT kernels) is dlopen'd at runtime. It also happens to have a CMake add_dependencies(PHY_COMMON dfts) edge today, so commit_impact.py already derives this correctly from the graph -- this rule is kept as an explicit floor in case that build-graph edge is ever refactored away without anyone noticing the impact-analysis regression.

rules.name: ldpc
rules.description: LDPC codec variants (ldpc, ldpc_orig, ldpc_ors, ldpc_cuda, ldpc_aal) are dlopen'd MODULEs. They also happen to have CMake add_dependencies(nr-softmodem/nr-uesoftmodem/... ldpc...) edges today, so commit_impact.py already derives this correctly -- this rule is kept as an explicit floor for the same reason as dfts above.
